title: A railroad town on the county line
text: Inyokern takes its name from its location near the border between Inyo and Kern Counties. It was a railroad town, established along the Southern Pacific's Lone Pine Branch, which has since been removed. That branch ran north from Mojave to Owenyo, a few miles north of Lone Pine, and was built around 1912 and used to help build the Los Angeles Aqueduct. Inyokern's first post office opened in 1910. The 2020 census counted 988 people, down from 1,099 in 2010.
